weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 牡羊座，是時候抽出一些時間來享受了！期待一項有趣的活動可以顯著減輕充滿挑戰的時刻的負擔。當你有一個目標時，你會對自己的韌性感到驚訝。這種觀點的轉變可以振奮你的精神，所以抓住機會掌控一切並設定你自己的獎勵。給自己一些令人愉快的事情，作為對你每天付出的努力的認可。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, it's time to carve out some time for enjoyment! Anticipating a fun activity can significantly ease the burdens of challenging moments. You'll be surprised at your resilience when you have a goal to aim for. This shift in perspective can uplift your spirits, so seize the opportunity to take charge and set up your own rewards. Treat yourself to something delightful as a nod to the effort you put in daily.
aries.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，請記住，每個人都有自己獨特的生活方式，重要的是不要僅僅因為他們的選擇與你自己的不同而做出判斷。雖然您可能傾向於傳統價值觀，但其他人可能對人際關係、職業和生活方式有不同的看法。這種多樣性可能對你來說難以理解，甚至可能讓人感到不安，但以同情而不是批評的態度對待他人至關重要。與其專注於他們的差異，不如將精力引導到維持自己的道路上。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, remember that everyone has their own unique way of living, and it's important not to pass judgment simply because their choices differ from your own. While you may lean towards traditional values, others may have a different perspective on relationships, careers, and lifestyles. This diversity might be challenging for you to grasp and could even feel unsettling, but it's essential to approach others with compassion rather than criticism. Instead of focusing on their differences, channel that energy into maintaining your own path.
taurus.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

gemini.horoscope: 今天，雙子座，你可能會發現自己周圍都是需要指導或安慰的朋友。您自然有能力提供他們所尋求的支持和同情。但是，請注意不要在過程中耗盡自己的能量。請記住，真正的友誼意味著共同分擔挑戰。如果你精疲力盡，你可能會發現很難幫助任何人。
gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you might find yourself surrounded by friends in need of guidance or a comforting ear. You're naturally equipped to offer the support and compassion they seek. However, be mindful not to deplete your own energy in the process. Remember, genuine friendship involves mutual sharing of challenges. If you exhaust yourself, you may find it hard to assist anyone at all.
gemini.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

cancer.horoscope: 今天，巨蟹座，處理你的任務對你來說應該很容易。如果你發現自己有時感覺有點遲鈍，請不要擔心；你可能會體驗到一股能量的爆發，這將重新點燃你的動力並幫助你完成你的專案。完成工作後，請考慮規劃一些有趣的活動，例如與朋友一起出去玩或參加激發您興趣的活動。你賺到了！
cancer.horoscope_en: Today, Cancer, tackling your tasks should come easily to you. If you find yourself feeling a bit sluggish at times, don’t worry; you’re likely to experience a burst of energy that will reignite your motivation and help you finish your projects. Once you wrap up your work, consider planning some enjoyable activities, like hanging out with friends or attending an event that piques your interest. You’ve earned it!
cancer.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

leo.horoscope: 今天，狮子座，你可能会因为周围的限制而感到有点窒息。當您能夠開拓自己的道路時，您自由奔放的天性就會蓬勃發展，而您最大的成功確實來自於追隨您獨特的願景。然而，规则是我们所有人都必须遵守的生活的一部分。首先专注于完成你的职责，一旦完成，你可能会发现更多的机会来表达你的独立性，而不会产生任何后果。記住要保持耐心並專注於你的任務。
leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, you might feel a bit stifled by the limitations around you. Your free-spirited nature thrives when you can carve your own path, and it's true that your greatest successes come from following your unique vision. However, rules are a part of life that we all must navigate. Focus on completing your responsibilities first, and once that's done, you'll likely discover more opportunities to express your independence without repercussions. Remember to practice patience and stay committed to your tasks.
leo.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

virgo.horoscope: 今天，您可能會精神抖擻，散發出積極的態度。將這種令人振奮的氛圍傳播給周圍那些可能正在掙扎的人。你開朗的舉止可以大大影響你的朋友、親人，甚至你的孩子。您社區和大家庭中的人可能會在您沒有註意到的情況下感受到您的快樂能量。如果您遇到情緒低落或不安的人，請向他們提供支持和鼓勵。請記住，最終一切都會水到渠成。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, you’re likely to be in high spirits and radiating positivity. Spread this uplifting vibe to those around you who may be struggling. Your cheerful demeanor can significantly influence your friends, loved ones, and even your children. Those in your community and extended family may sense your joyful energy, often without you noticing. If you encounter someone who is feeling down or upset, offer them your support and encouragement. Remember, in the end, everything will fall into place.

libra.horoscope: 天秤座，請記得珍惜你尋找解決方案的非凡能力。如果您感覺缺乏資源或訊息，請花點時間反思一下。考慮一下您的人脈—您可以聯絡到誰？您有哪些工具或知識可供使用？不要強調缺少的要素，而是編制潛在聯絡人清單並採取行動。對自己的能力有信心。
libra.horoscope_en: Libra, remember to value your remarkable ability to find solutions. If you're feeling short on resources or information, take a moment to reflect. Consider your network—who can you reach out to? What tools or knowledge do you have at your disposal? Instead of stressing over the missing elements, compile a list of potential contacts and take action. Have faith in your capabilities.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，不要讓憂鬱壓垮你。儘管有些日子可能感覺很慢，但讓自己忙碌起來會讓時間過得很快。專注於完成任何未完成的任務，並考慮安排一個有趣的夜晚。當地平線上出現一線希望時，不僅時間會過得更快，而且你也會因為知道自己已接近終點線而感到安慰。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Don't let the melancholy weigh you down, Scorpio. Although some days may feel slow, keeping yourself occupied will help time fly by. Focus on wrapping up any outstanding tasks and consider making arrangements for a fun night out. With a glimmer of hope on the horizon, not only will the hours seem to pass more quickly, but you'll also find comfort in knowing that you're nearing the finish line.

sagittarius.horoscope: 擁抱你的獨特性，射手座！陷入單調的日常生活太簡單了——在同一時間吃飯和睡覺，堅持穿著同樣的衣服，並以熟悉的方式完成你的任務。不久之後，你可能會發現自己陷入困境。擺脫這個循環的關鍵是做出有意識的選擇來改變現狀。嘗試新的髮型，探索以前從未嘗試過的鮮豔顏色，或者如果您感覺特別喜歡冒險，請考慮改變職業。拓寬你的視野！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Embrace your uniqueness, Sagittarius! It's all too simple to slip into a monotonous routine—having your meals and sleep at the same hour, sticking to the same wardrobe, and approaching your tasks in a familiar manner. Before long, you might find yourself stuck in a groove. The key to escaping this cycle is to make a conscious choice to shake things up. Experiment with a fresh hairstyle, explore vibrant colors you haven't tried before, or if you're feeling particularly adventurous, think about a career change. Broaden your perspectives!
sagittarius.lucky_disclaimer: 幸運色／幸運時間由本 App 依星座與日期自動生成，非真實命理來源，僅供參考娛樂。

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，擁抱你今天獨特的生活方式，不要讓自我懷疑蔓延開來。你所做的選擇是出於有意義的原因，這是值得自豪的事。即使您正在考慮轉變，也沒有理由對當前的道路感到尷尬。每個人都在打造自己的旅程，無論是否符合主流。兩條路徑都是完全有效的。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Capricorn, embrace your unique lifestyle today and don't let self-doubt creep in. You made choices for meaningful reasons, and that's something to be proud of. Even if you're contemplating a shift, there's no reason to feel awkward about your current path. Each person forges their own journey, whether it aligns with the mainstream or not. Both paths are perfectly valid.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現你的決心增強了，為你提供了精力充沛地完成任務的能量。現在是結束所有懸而未決的項目並考慮下一步要接受哪些挑戰的最佳時機。毫不猶豫地擁抱任何複雜或雄心勃勃的努力；你有能力管理好這一切，並且成就感會很豐厚。抓住每一個出現在你面前的機會。祝你有美好的一天！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you may find your determination heightened, providing you with the energy to tackle your tasks with vigor. It's a perfect time to wrap up any lingering projects and consider what challenges you want to take on next. Embrace any complex or ambitious endeavors without hesitation; you have the capability to manage it all, and the sense of accomplishment will be rewarding. Seize every opportunity that comes your way. Have a wonderful day!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你感受到今天平靜的行星排列的微妙影響了嗎？不用擔心;這個階段轉瞬即逝。專注於逐步解決任務，並考慮為今晚安排一些有趣的活動。無論是與朋友聚會還是欣賞電影，保持專注和專注都會振奮精神。很快，你就會發現你的心情明顯好轉了。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, are you sensing the subtle influence of today's calm planetary alignments? Don't worry; this phase is fleeting. Focus on tackling tasks gradually and consider arranging some enjoyable activities for tonight. Whether it's gathering with friends or enjoying a film, keeping yourself engaged and centered will lift your spirits. Soon enough, you'll find your mood has brightened significantly.
